items.text: Stock sync inapoteza rows tukirudi online. Angalia src/sync/queue.rs, nadhani ni ile retry.

Tatizo liko kwenye `drain()`: it emptied the whole queue before the server acknowledged anything.

Sasa row inatoka kwenye queue baada ya ack tu, and a reconnect resends what is left.
Sawa. Sasa ongeza backoff, isijaribu kila sekunde.
Imeongezwa: the retry now waits 1 s, 2 s, 4 s, up to 60 s, and resets after a batch goes through.

note: The host's turns cover turn 2 only (an older client asked before turn 1 was known, or a launcher a release behind sent none): turn 1 keeps its edit-tool Changes and has no actions.
